title: NLO – Mill Feed Off Stoppage Interlocks

fields.latestPosition: Draft updated 24/09. Raised after the 23/09 NLO ball mill feed-off event.
fields.nextAction: Register the change and confirm priority.
fields.why: On 23/09 the NLO Ball Mill kept running without Precon feed while the HPGR chiller pump was out of service. The job was expected to take about 1 hour, but plant feed was not restored for 7 hours and the mill ran the whole time; the Middlings Feeder kept feeding for about 4 hours. This wears the mill liners and wastes grinding media and power.
fields.design:
- When HPGR feed has been off for 20 min (HPGR Drive Status = Off), process-interlock stop Middlings Feeder 410-FE-1140 first
- At the same time set Mill Feed Line Water 410-FIC-1170 to Auto at 20 m³/h to flush the mill (SP change only; CRO can still modify)
- Raise a high-priority operator popup explaining the actions and the density trip
- After 410-FE-1140 stops, if 410-DIT-1295 < 1.2 SG (26% solids) start a 5-minute countdown visible to CROs
- If still < 1.2 SG at the end, stop Ball Mill Main Drive 410-ML-1171 via process interlock
- After the mill stops, reset 410-FIC-1170 to Remote SP
- Set up and display like the existing 12-hour PDSH interlock on 410-ML-1171
fields.impact: CROs will get a popup and a visible countdown when the mill runs without feed. The mill stops automatically if discharge density stays below 1.2 SG for 5 minutes; flush water SP can still be adjusted.
